_comment: Day-of-week/public-holiday surcharge patch added 2026-09-12 (docs/cliniko-day-of-week-holiday-surcharge-design.md) -- Physio Cure's KB states a $10 Saturday / $15 Sunday / $20 public-holiday surcharge, backed by 3 real Cliniko billable_items previously unlinked to any appointment type (migration 309, cliniko_day_surcharges table). build_day_surcharge_pricing_patch() in scripts/generate_node8.py is the reusable builder behind this patch -- any future Cliniko clinic with a confirmed day-of-week surcharge should get an equivalent scenario set.

scenarios.name: DSP1 — price ask naming a Saturday states base price plus surcharge total

history.content: How much is a private initial consultation on Saturday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node calls smart_voice_agent intent=get_service_price with the matched appointment_type_id (e.g. 1167091570785125832) AND appointment_date reflecting 'Saturday', then, once the tool result returns price=$160, day_surcharge_price=$10, day_surcharge_label='Saturday surcharge', total_price_with_surcharge=$170, states the total inclusive of the surcharge (e.g. 'It's $160, plus a Saturday surcharge of $10 for that date, so $170 in total.') and never speaks the note field verbatim. FAIL if appointment_date is omitted from the payload, if only the base $160 is quoted with no mention of the surcharge, or if the note field is spoken.

scenarios.name: DSP2 — plain price ask with no date given states only the base price (fleet-safe regression)

history.content: How much is a private initial consultation?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node calls smart_voice_agent intent=get_service_price with the matched appointment_type_id and no appointment_date (no day/date was stated or already known), then, once the tool result returns only price=$160 with no day_surcharge_price field, states just 'It's $160.' with no surcharge mentioned. FAIL if the node invents a date, asks an unnecessary clarifying question about which day, or mentions a surcharge with no date-carrying tool result to justify it.

scenarios.name: DSP3 — duration-only ask is unaffected by the surcharge patch

history.content: How long does the initial consultation take?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node calls smart_voice_agent intent=get_service_duration (no price intent, no appointment_date needed) and states only the duration once the tool returns (e.g. 'It runs for 40 minutes.'). FAIL if the node calls a price intent, mentions any dollar figure or surcharge, or asks about a specific day/date.

scenarios.name: DSP4 — caller already has a Saturday slot offered this call, date is reused without re-asking

history.content: I have Saturday the 12th of September at 10am available for a Private Initial Consultation — would that work?
Actually, before I confirm, how much will that cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node calls smart_voice_agent intent=get_service_price with the matched appointment_type_id AND appointment_date reflecting the already-offered Saturday date (not asking the caller to restate it), then states the surcharge-inclusive total once returned. FAIL if the node asks the caller what date they mean when a specific date was already offered this call, or omits appointment_date despite the date being known.
